name: explainer-video-studio
description: Create storyboard-based explainer videos using Codex image generation, Real-ESRGAN upscaling, OpenAI voiceover, and local FFmpeg composition.

interface.longDescription: Uses Codex's built-in image generation for visual assets, the Explainer Media MCP server for Real-ESRGAN upscaling and OpenAI TTS, and FFmpeg in the project workspace for scene splitting and final rendering.
defaultPrompt: Create a 40-second explainer video from this topic.
Turn this script into a storyboard video with voiceover.
Generate an explainer video using a single storyboard image.
